query:
SELECT p.id, p.name, p.creditLimit, p.currentBalance,
  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CAST(s.finalAmount AS DECIMAL(10,2))), 0) FROM sales s WHERE s.customerId = p.id AND s.saleType = 'A_PRAZO' AND s.status = 'ACTIVE') as totalSales,
  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CAST(cp.paidAmount AS DECIMAL(10,2))), 0) FROM customerPayments cp WHERE cp.customerId = p.id) as totalPayments,
  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CAST(cd.debitAmount AS DECIMAL(10,2))), 0) FROM customerDebits cd WHERE cd.customerId = p.id) as totalDebits
FROM partners p 
WHERE p.name LIKE '%Ricardo Pereira%'
LIMIT 5;
